trigger: Team turned two-factor off from the admin page (admin.js)
subject: Two-factor sign-in was turned off by our team
footer_note: You're getting this because you have a VF Tech account. Account emails like this one can't be turned off.
body: As you asked, we turned off two-factor sign-in for your VFTech account and signed out every device. Sign in with your email, then turn two-factor on again from your account page with your new phone.
